Lower Text: [Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When this Digimon would digivolve, if you have a green Tamer, reduce the digivolution cost by 1.
Upper Text: [Main] By suspending this Digimon, 1 of your Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with [Fairy] in one of its traits in the hand for the digivolution cost. When it would digivolve by this effect, reduce the digivolution cost by 2.
